description:
You are organizing a legal research library. A previous research assistant tagged several cases with 'Equal Protection', but for your upcoming publication, you need to standardize this to the more formal 'Equal Protection Clause'.

Your goal is to rename the existing tag 'Equal Protection' to 'Equal Protection Clause' globally across the library. 

1. Locate the 'Equal Protection' tag in the tag selector panel (bottom-left of the Jurism window).
2. Use the context menu (right-click) to rename the tag to exactly 'Equal Protection Clause'.

When finished, the old tag should be gone, and all items previously tagged with it (Brown v. Board, Obergefell v. Hodges, Gideon v. Wainwright) should now have the new tag.
